title: High-Rate Concatenated Quantum Error-Correcting Codes for Qudits
summary: Qudits provide a larger local Hilbert space than qubits and have recently attracted interest as building blocks for efficient fault-tolerant quantum computation (FTQC). In this work, we extend many-hypercube (MHC) codes, high-rate concatenated quantum codes, from qubits to qudits of prime dimension $q$. We construct the level-2 and level-3 MHC codes with parameters $\left[\!\left[6^2,4^2,2^2\right]\!\right]_q$ and $\left[\!\left[6^3,4^3,2^3\right]\!\right]_q$, respectively, and generalize the level-by-level minimum-distance (LLMD) decoder originally proposed for the qubit MHC codes.
